examples.label: Recipe method steps under a heading
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Method <.component component_name="chelekom-ol" site="Global" class="space-y-2"> <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Rinse the paper filter and warm the brewer with just-boiled water. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Grind 18 g of coffee to about the coarseness of table salt. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Pour 60 g of water, wait forty seconds for the bloom, then fill to 300 g. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Stir once, let the bed draw down, and serve within a minute.

examples.label: Numbered onboarding checklist in a bordered list
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Finish setting up your workspace <.component component_name="chelekom-ol" site="Global" variant="bordered" color="natural" rounded="medium"> <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="small">Invite the two people who review your drafts. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="small">Point your domain at the CMS and wait for the certificate. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="small">Publish the home page so the site stops answering 404. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="small">Turn on nightly backups from the storage settings.

examples.label: Refund policy clauses with bold lead-ins
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Refunds <.component component_name="chelekom-ol" site="Global" class="space-y-3" size="small"> <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Within fourteen days. Unopened items go back for a full refund to the original payment method. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Between fifteen and thirty days. We issue store credit at the price you paid, minus return shipping. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Faulty on arrival.
